summary: Tectonic Therapeutic, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on November 5, 2026 furnishing third-quarter 2026 financial results and a business update under Item 2.02, with the press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. The release reports favorable single ascending-dose Phase 1a safety, tolerability and PK data for TX2100, an FDA Fast Track designation for hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia and IND clearance, first patient dosing in the ALPINE Phase 2a trial of TX45, and cash of $234.7 million at September 30, 2026. No transaction, ownership change or board action is disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings current report, not a special situation. Watch clinical catalysts, notably APEX Phase 2 topline by end-January 2027 and ALPINE interim data in second-half 2027.
